verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents custom application-form questions, knockout or disqualification rules, or EEOC/demographic data collection. The nearby items are about other things: career-site contact forms, an onboarding AI Form Builder, a generic "custom, flexible configurations" claim, and an API endpoint for creating applications. None of them shows the product shaping application forms.

support.subject: As a recruiter, application forms are mine to shape — custom questions, knockout rules, and EEOC/demographic collection handled compliantly
